INSERT INTO identity_provider_grant
                (provider_id, org_id, group_name, tenant_id, role, created_by)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
            ON CONFLICT (provider_id, group_name, tenant_id)
            DO UPDATE SET role = EXCLUDED.role,
                          created_at = now(),
                          created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
